title: Joint FCA and SRA warning on motor finance claims and termination fees
summary: The FCA and SRA have jointly warned firms handling motor finance commission claims. They expect checks that clients have no other representative, and any termination fee to be reasonable.
what_changes: The regulators expect firms to have robust checks to confirm a client has not already instructed another representative.
Fees for switching or ending an agreement must be reasonable and reflect the work done.
Law firms can only bill in line with the agreement signed before work started, and any termination fee must have been stated up front.
The regulators expect duplicate claims to be resolved through efficient, cost-effective co-operation between firms.
who_it_applies_to: SRA-regulated law firms that act for consumers in motor finance commission claims.

history.event: FCA and SRA issued a joint warning on motor finance commission claims.
